name: Lazaro Kawer
intro: I build measurement and evaluation systems for AI agents and operating systems.
biography: I'm a Senior Research Engineer and AI Evaluation Lead in Windows Fundamentals at Microsoft. My work connects AI agent evaluation, operating-system performance, and the statistical systems used to make engineering decisions.

I start by defining what needs to be measured. That can mean turning a reported experience into an observable system signal, or deciding what evidence is enough to trust an agent's proposed code change. I build the instrumentation, evaluation, and software around that question.
I stay close to implementation as the work grows into a team effort. My technical interests include expert-calibrated evaluation, experimental design, performance tails, and on-device prediction.
Before Microsoft, I interned on Apple's Siri Search team and on Google Search and Cloud. I studied computer science at ITESM Monterrey.
